exposure: Free health care policy for women
Out-of-pocket (OOP) payments for delivery and obstetric care
Type of delivery (normal, dystocia, cesarean section)
outcome: Direct health expenditures for delivery and obstetric care
cohort: Women (n=587) who had delivered or received obstetric care on the day of the survey in Burkina Faso
finding: While the free healthcare policy in Burkina Faso was effective for financial protection, nearly one-third of women still incurred out-of-pocket payments for deliveries and obstetric care, with factors like age, emergency care need, and health region influencing OOP occurrence and amount.
